27471-the-wall-between.title: The Wall Between
27471-the-wall-between.creator: Sara Ware Bassett
27471-the-wall-between.description: A book by Sara Ware Bassett. The Howe and Webster farms adjoined, lying on a sun-flooded, gently sloping New Hampshire hillside. Between them loomed The Wall. It was not a high wall. On the contrary, its formidableness was the result of tradition rather than of fact. For more than a century it had been an estranging barrier to neighborliness, to courtesy, to broad-mindedness; a barrier to friendship, to Christian charity, to peace.

68462-einstein-and-the-universe-a-popula.title: Einstein And The Universe A Popular Exposition Of The Famous
68462-einstein-and-the-universe-a-popula.creator: Unknown
68462-einstein-and-the-universe-a-popula.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. dation of all the  sciences—Ascending the stream of time—The speed of  light an impassable limit—The addition of speeds  and Fizeau’s experiment—Variability of mass—The  ballistics of electrons—Gravitation and light as  atomic microcosms—Matter and energy—The death of         the sun_                                           pp.

6965-alice-sit-by-the-fire.title: Alice Sit By The Fire
6965-alice-sit-by-the-fire.creator: J. M. Barrie
6965-alice-sit-by-the-fire.description: A book by J. M. Barrie. novelist can have sixteen chapters about the hero’s grandparents, but we cannot even say he had any unless he says it himself. There can be no rummaging in the past for us to show what sort of people our characters are; we are allowed only to present them as they toe the mark; then the handkerchief falls, and off they go.

72387-the-delinquent-vol-iv-no-6-june-19.title: The Delinquent Vol Iv No 6 June 1914
72387-the-delinquent-vol-iv-no-6-june-19.creator: Edith R. Spaulding, M. D.
72387-the-delinquent-vol-iv-no-6-june-19.description: A book by Edith R. Spaulding, M. D.. Two hundred and five of the cases studied have received a psychological examination. This has included the history of their educational advantages and a study of the results obtained, as well as psychological tests which estimate native ability aside from formal educational training. In all doubtful cases, or in cases in which there appeared to be mental defect, the Binet-Simon tests have also been used.

arxiv-1906-11667.title: Evolving Robust Neural Architectures to Defend from Adversarial Attacks
arxiv-1906-11667.creator: Shashank Kotyan, Danilo Vasconcellos Vargas
arxiv-1906-11667.description: Abstract Neural networks are prone to misclassify slightly modified input images. Recently, many defences have been proposed, but none have improved the robustness of neural networks consistently. Here, we propose to use adversarial attacks as a function evaluation to search for neural architectures that can resist such attacks automatically.

arxiv-2306-15677.title: Measuring the continuous research impact of a researcher: The K z K_{z} index
arxiv-2306-15677.creator: Kiran Sharma, Ziya Uddin
arxiv-2306-15677.description: Abstract The ongoing discussion regarding the utilization of individual research performance for academic hiring, funding allocation, and resource distribution has prompted the need for improved metrics. While traditional measures such as total publications, citations count, and the h h -index provide a general overview of research impact, they fall short of capturing the continuous contribution of researchers over time.

arxiv-2308-06424.title: Multiclass Learnability Does Not Imply Sample Compression
arxiv-2308-06424.creator: Chirag Pabbaraju
arxiv-2308-06424.description: Abstract A hypothesis class admits a sample compression scheme, if for every sample labeled by a hypothesis from the class, it is possible to retain only a small subsample, using which the labels on the entire sample can be inferred. The size of the compression scheme is an upper bound on the size of the subsample produced.

arxiv-2312-04698.title: Positive scalar curvature metrics and aspherical summands
arxiv-2312-04698.creator: Shuli Chen, Jianchun Chu, Jintian Zhu
arxiv-2312-04698.description: Abstract . We prove for n ∈ { 3 , 4 , 5 } n\in\{3,4,5\} that the connected sum of a closed aspherical n n -manifold with an arbitrary non-compact manifold does not admit a complete metric with nonnegative scalar curvature. In particular, a special case of our result answers a question of Gromov.

arxiv-2406-09121.title: MMRel: A Relation Understanding Benchmark in the MLLM Era
arxiv-2406-09121.creator: Jiahao Nie Gongjie Zhang Wenbin An Yap-Peng Tan Alex C. Kot Shijian Lu
arxiv-2406-09121.description: Abstract Though Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently achieved significant progress, they often face various problems while handling inter-object relations, i.e . , the interaction or association among distinct objects. This constraint largely stems from insufficient training and evaluation data for relation understanding, which has greatly impeded MLLMs in various vision-language generation and reasoning tasks.

arxiv-2410-16461.title: Comparative Study of Multilingual Idioms and Similes in Large Language Models
arxiv-2410-16461.creator: Paria Khoshtab Danial Namazifard, Mostafa Masoudi Ali Akhgary Samin Mahdizadeh Sani, Yadollah Yaghoobzadeh
arxiv-2410-16461.description: Abstract This study addresses the gap in the literature concerning the comparative performance of LLMs in interpreting different types of figurative language across multiple languages. By evaluating LLMs using two multilingual datasets on simile and idiom interpretation, we explore the effectiveness of various prompt engineering strategies, including chain-of-thought, few-shot, and English translation prompts.

arxiv-2411-06797.title: Implementation of CNOT quantum gate by nonlinear coupled electro nano-optomechanical oscillators
arxiv-2411-06797.creator: Reihaneh Alinaghipour, Hamidreza Mohammadi​​
arxiv-2411-06797.description: Abstract A Feasibility study is done for the possibility of a universal set of quantum gate implementation based on phononic state via fourth-order Duffing nonlinearity in an optomechanical system. The optomechanical system consists of N N doubly clamped coupled nanobeam arrays driven by local static and radio frequency electrical potentials, coupled to a single-mode high-finesse optical cavity.

arxiv-2502-20176.title: DGFM: Full Body Dance Generation Driven by Music Foundation Models Thanks: This paper was presented at the Audio Imagination Workshop of NeurlPS 2024, but it has not been formally published in any conference proceedings or journals.
arxiv-2502-20176.creator: Xinran Liu, Zhenhua Feng, Diptesh Kanojia, Wenwu Wang
arxiv-2502-20176.description: Abstract In music-driven dance motion generation, most existing methods use hand-crafted features and neglect that music foundation models have profoundly impacted cross-modal content generation. To bridge this gap, we propose a diffusion-based method that generates dance movements conditioned on text and music.

arxiv-2505-04014.title: Rollbaccine : Herd Immunity against Storage Rollback Attacks in TEEs (Technical Report)
arxiv-2505-04014.creator: David C. Y. Chu, Aditya Balasubramanian, Dee Bao, Natacha Crooks, Heidi Howard, Lucky E. Katahanas, Soujanya Ponnapalli
arxiv-2505-04014.description: Abstract . Today, users can “lift-and-shift” unmodified applications into modern, VM-based Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) in order to gain hardware-based security guarantees. However, TEEs do not protect applications against disk rollback attacks, where persistent storage can be reverted to an earlier state after a crash; existing rollback resistance solutions either only support a subset of applications or require code modification.

arxiv-2505-09000.title: Cyclic system for an algebraic theory of alternating parity automata
arxiv-2505-09000.creator: Anupam Das and Abhishek De
arxiv-2505-09000.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anupam Das and Abhishek De. ω \omega -regular languages are a natural extension of the regular languages to the setting of infinite words. Likewise, they are recognised by a host of automata models, one of the most important being Alternating Parity Automata (APAs), a generalisation of Büchi automata that symmetrises both the transitions (with universal as well as existential branching) and the acceptance condition (by a parity condition).

arxiv-2508-12272.title: Lipshitz–Sarkar stable homotopy type for certain planar trivalent graphs with perfect matchings
arxiv-2508-12272.creator: Nilangshu Bhattacharyya
arxiv-2508-12272.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nilangshu Bhattacharyya. We develop a space-level refinement of the 2 2 -factor homology [ Bal23 ] by constructing a stable homotopy type associated to a certain family 𝒢 \mathscr{G} of planar trivalent graphs equipped with perfect matchings.

plos-pone-0009277.creator: João Pedro Pereira, Jason G. Cyster, Ying Xu
plos-pone-0009277.description: PLOS ONE research article. B lymphocyte egress from secondary lymphoid organs requires sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P) and S1P receptor-1 (S1P1). However, whether S1P contributes to immature-B cell egress from the bone marrow (BM) has not been fully assessed. Here we report that in S1P- and S1P1-conditionall

pmc-10665798.title: Human diphyllobothriosis in Taiwan: A review of cases and molecular evidence of Dibothriocephalus nihonkaiensis
pmc-10665798.creator: Chia-Kwung Fan, Daniel Barčák, Tomáš Scholz, Pasaikou Sonko, Martina Orosová, Kua-Eyre Su, Chun-Chao Chang, Yuarn-Jang Lee, Roman Kuchta, Mikuláš Oros
pmc-10665798.description: Diphyllobothriosis is an infectious disease caused by the consumption of raw freshwater or marine fish containing larvae of broad tapeworms (Diphyllobothriidae). In the present study, we critically reviewed all cases of human diphyllobothriosis reported from Taiwan, including unpublished reports from hospitals in Taipei.

pmc-11596521.title: Aberrant basement membrane production by HSCs in MASLD is attenuated by the bile acid analog INT-767
pmc-11596521.creator: Prakash Ramachandran, Madara Brice, Elena F. Sutherland, Anna M. Hoy, Eleni Papachristoforou, Li Jia, Frances Turner, Timothy J. Kendall, John A. Marwick, Neil O. Carragher, Denise Oro, Michael Feigh, Diana J. Leeming, Mette J. Nielsen, Morten A. Karsdal, Nadine Hartmann, Mary Erickson, Luciano Ador
pmc-11596521.description: Background:The farnesoid X receptor (FXR) is a leading therapeutic target for metabolic dysfunction–associated steatohepatitis (MASH)-related fibrosis. INT-767, a potent FXR agonist, has shown promise in preclinical models. We aimed to define the mechanisms of INT-767 activity in experimental MASH and dissect cellular and molecular targets of FXR agonism in human disease.

pmc-11671365.title: Comparative analysis of creative problem solving tasks across age groups using modular cube robotics
pmc-11671365.creator: Mehedi Hasan Anik, Margarida Romero
pmc-11671365.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Creative Problem Solving (CPS) is an important competency when using digital artifacts for educational purposes. Using a dual-process approach, this study examines the divergent thinking scores (fluidity, flexibility, and originality) and problem-solving speed in CPS of different age groups. Participants engaged in CreaCube CPS tasks with educational robotics for two consecutive instances, with performance analyzed to explore the influence of prior experience and creative intentions.

pmc-11688376.title: Deep learning-based automation for segmentation and biometric measurement of the gestational sac in ultrasound images
pmc-11688376.creator: Hafiz Muhammad Danish, Zobia Suhail, Faiza Farooq
pmc-11688376.description: IntroductionMonitoring the morphological features of the gestational sac (GS) and measuring the mean sac diameter (MSD) during early pregnancy are essential for predicting spontaneous miscarriage and estimating gestational age (GA). However, the manual process is labor-intensive and highly dependent on the sonographer's expertise.

pmc-11690382.title: INDIGENOUS EXPLANATORY MODELS OF DEMENTIA: RESULTS FROM HEALTHY OLDER ADULTS IN NORTH AMERICA
pmc-11690382.creator: Kristen Jacklin, Melissa Blind, Wayne Warry, Nickolas Lambrou, Carey Gleason, Megan Zuelsdorff, Dana Ketcher
pmc-11690382.description: Explanatory models of illness are important concepts in understanding a person’s beliefs about an illness and the social meaning that is attributed to that illness. This project seeks to understand an explanatory model of Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD) among healthy older adults in four diverse Indigenous communities in the US (Minnesota, Wisconsin) and Canada (Ontario).

pmc-12749911.title: The Artemisia argyi oil reduces high-fat diet-induced obesity by enhancing thermogenesis in brown adipose tissue
pmc-12749911.creator: Shuai Wang, ShengLan Lin, Fuan Xie, Shuting Liu, Ting He, Kun Chen, Zhengrong Huang, Wenlong Xie, Hongqiu Cheng, Jian Zhang, Weihua Li
pmc-12749911.description: Amid growing global concerns over obesity, the identification of novel lipid resources with potential health benefits has become a key focus in food science. Artemisia argyi, a traditional edible plant, is valued for its bioactive volatile oils, yet the effects of Artemisia argyi oil (AAO) on lipid metabolism and energy balance remain largely unexplored.

pmc-13223333.title: Thinner-than-paper and broad-temperature-adaptive zinc-iodine batteries enabled by nanophase separated deep-eutectic hydrogel electrolytes
pmc-13223333.creator: Tianyu Shen, Zong-Ju Chen, Yongxin Yang, Qianchuan Yu, Jingyi Wang, Kexin Hou, Wei Meng, Junchuan Liang, Yiming Yang, Hongguang Liu, Zuoxiu Tie, Cheng-Hui Li, Zhong Jin
pmc-13223333.description: Hydrogel electrolyte based secondary batteries are promising for wearable electronics, yet face challenges including limited mechanical resilience, and narrow temperature range. Herein, we report a robust deep-eutectic hydrogel electrolyte fabricated via synergistic interplay of dual nanophase separation, hydrated eutectic solvation, and hydrogen-bond networks.

pmc-13254010.title: Demoralization and Associated Factors in Palliative Oncology Outpatients: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13254010.creator: Michael Ljuslin, Vasileios Chytas, Marie‐Estelle Gaignard, Daniel Gorman, Kate Lally, Emanuele Mazzola, Kabir Nigam, Sholevar Roxanne, Zachary Sager, Miryam Yusufov, Sophie Pautex, James Aaron Tulsky, Yvan Beaussant
pmc-13254010.description: BackgroundDemoralization is common in palliative psycho‐oncology settings. Although its relationship with other psycho‐existential conditions has been scrutinized, its co‐occurrence with adjustment disorder, as measured by the Adjustment Disorder New Module‐20 (ADNM‐20), remains unexamined.AimEstimate frequency and co‐occurrence of demoralization and adjustment disorder symptom domains among palliative outpatients and examine sociodemographic and psycho‐existential factors.

pmc-13406594.title: Combined Influence of Subjective Cognitive Complaints and Neuropsychiatric Symptoms on Cognitive Trajectories in Older Adults
pmc-13406594.creator: Cindy Zhang, Ashleigh S. Vella, Russell J. Chander, Henry Brodaty, Perminder S. Sachdev, Katya Numbers
pmc-13406594.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Individuals with neuropsychiatric symptoms had significant associations with domain-specific cognitive outcomes, including visuospatial ability and executive function, and global cognition.Having both subjective cognitive complaints and neuropsychiatric symptoms was associated with elevated risk of incident dementia, more so than having either symptom. What are the implications of the main findings?

pmc-13407526.title: Editorial: RNA helicases: pioneering therapeutic avenues in cancer treatment
pmc-13407526.creator: Lidia Chellini, Takahiko Murayama
pmc-13407526.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). he importance of these enzymes not only in RNA metabolism but also in the maintenance of genome stability, cellular stress responses, and immune regulation, positioning them as attractive targets for cancer therapy. The aim of this Research Topic is to provide new evidence supporting the functional relevance of RNA helicases as cancer-associated regulators while highlighting molecular mechanisms that may be exploited for therapeutic intervention.

pmc-13499374.title: Mortality among patients with aneurysmal SAH in a nationwide unselected cohort
pmc-13499374.creator: Agnes T Stauning, John Hauerberg, Trine Stavngaard, George F Mkoma, Tina N Munch
pmc-13499374.description: IntroductionAneurysmal subarachnoid haemorrhage is a severe condition with reported in-hospital mortality ranging from 7.1% to 24.1%, but the term in-hospital mortality is not consistently defined, and methodological limitations persist in studies investigating mortality and potential risk factors for mortality. In Denmark, nearly all patients with aSAH are admitted to a neurosurgical department and recorded in a nationwide registry.

pmc-13579902.title: Uncovering the impact of co-infections on disease severity and mortality in pulmonary cryptococcosis
pmc-13579902.creator: Luling Wu, Xuemin Fu, Ling Weng, Benno Pütz, Renfang Zhang, Li Liu, Yueming Shao, Zhihang Zheng, Jingna Xun, Ximei Han, Ting Wang, Yinzhong Shen, Hongzhou Lu, Bertram Müller-Myhsok, Jun Chen
pmc-13579902.description: BackgroundIncreasing case reports and monocentric studies suggest that co-infections may be associated with poorer outcomes in patients with pulmonary cryptococcosis (PC), including both people living with HIV (PLWH) and HIV-negative individuals. However, systematic cohort-based evidence evaluating the prognostic impact of co-infections remains limited.

uslaw-usc-t25-s403b.title: 25 U.S.C. § 403b — Lease of restricted lands in State of Washington
uslaw-usc-t25-s403b.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s403b.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 12 (Lease, Sale, Or Surrender Of Allotted Or Unallotted Lands). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Notwithstanding any other provisions of law, with the consent in writing of the individual Indian, association of Indians, or Indian tribe concerned, any restricted Indian lands situated within the State of Washington may be leased for religious, educational, recreational, business.
